[LTAC.2.2] An `after` clause's duration is a duration literal, a `UNIT_LIT`
whose unit is on the `time` axis ([LGRA.6.1]): `30_s`, `5_min`, `2_h`. A named or
computed duration does not parse. The compiler must refuse a unit of another
dimension with `DS_VALIDATE_BAD_UNIT_DIMENSION`, as at every duration position
([LLEX.12.8]). An author needing a runtime duration writes a sibling rule that
asserts a custom timer fact.
